intro: The Southsea Treasure is a valuable hoard kept deep within the hold of the Southsea Freebooter vessel, the Tide Razor. Sought by Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet, retrieving it tests the lockpicking and infiltration skills of fledgling thieves.

p: Anchored along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, the pirate vessel Tide Razor serves as a forward base and training ground for the Southsea Freebooters. Stashed deep in its lowest hold lies a coveted stash of plunder known as the Southsea Treasure. Wrenix the Wretched, a goblin scoundrel operating out of Ratchet, considers it the ultimate test for aspiring pickpockets. According to Wrenix, the last five operatives sent to filch the chest returned in pieces, owing to the alert pirates aboard and a surprisingly ferocious guardian guarding the hold.
